THE ZERO-CROSSING MICROSCOPE

 
This chamber explains cancellation at known critical-line zeros. It does not determine whether off-line zeros exist. The audio, when invited, is the main sum itself, resampled at the one declared dilation; a zero is staged as silence only while that audio is actually passing through it. 2πn² is the height at which term n enters the sum, never a frequency; the frequency is (θ′(t) − log n)/2π.
